# CANDIDATE: VIX_SPIKE_MEANREV_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A short-term VIX spike often mean-reverts, providing a tailwind for SPY longs when price is near VWAP. The edge exists because VIX spikes reflect temporary fear overreaction, and mean reversion in VIX correlates with short-term SPY upside when SPY is not extended above VWAP.

## Mechanism

Entry: At the close of a 1-minute bar where (1) the 1-minute VIX close exceeds its prior close by ≥0.3 points, (2) SPY price ≤ VWAP(5-min) + 0.1×ATR(14), and (3) VIX is falling on that bar (current VIX close < prior VIX close).  
Exit: Initial stop at 0.5×ATR below entry or at the level where VIX closes below its prior close. Target at 1.5R or when VIX returns to within 0.1 points of its prior close.  
Regime filter: Only active when VIX is between 14‑26 and time between 10:00‑14:30 EST; avoid during FOMC or major economic releases.
